tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The costing shall include transportation, any Indian duties, sales and other taxes charges and exclude GST charges
Bidder Should submit Accurate postal Address and Contact Number
Supplier Manufacturer must be ISO certified for quality and other certificates which are mandatory for the chemicals used for NABL recognisable microbiology Laboratory
For more details refer bid document & tender notification and estimates uploaded MANDATORILY

Warranty / Guarantee: Bid must include five year comprehensive on-site warranty / guarantee and annual maintenance including all components and accessories. These will be effective from the date of the satisfactory installation / commissioning of equipment. The guarantee/warranty would also be valid for any manufacturing detects, workmanship and poor quality of the components
Accessories purchased and installed should be covered by CMC/AMC/External calibration for five year period including spare parts
Right of acceptance or Rejection of any or all tenders with or without any is reserved with undersigned or any concerned higher officers of the department

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of experience and past performance of the tenderer those of same nature within the past three/five years and details of current contracts in hand and other commitments.

The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured,tested and supplied the items specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80 % of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years.The items offered for supply must be of the most recent series incorporating the latest improvements and Items should not be expired or nearing expiry within the next year or so.
